findings.title: API success dropped to 75% during the fault
findings.evidence: 16 requests, status counts {'200': 9, '503': 4, '204': 3}, p95 214.0 ms (baseline 41.2 ms)

summary: Stopping `policies` (container_stop) moved API success from 100% to 75% across 16 samples; 1 service affected; recovered in 42 s without intervention. The safety monitor aborted early (operator_stop).
production_implication: In production a container_stop on policies would be absorbed with little or no user-visible impact.
